test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The truth was __revealed __in the interrogation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Concealed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"revealed"** means to make known something that was previously hidden or unknown. (प्रकट किया)

 
 
• **Example: **The magician revealed the secret behind his trick.
 
 
 
• **"Concealed"** refers to something that is hidden or kept secret. (छिपाया हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The treasure was concealed under the old oak tree.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'revealed'** is **'concealed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Concealed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Evident** (स्पष्ट): Something that is clear and obvious.

 
 
• **Example:** The joy on her face was evident to everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **Found** (पाया गया): Something that is discovered or located.
 
 
• **Example: **They found the missing keys under the couch.
 
 
 
• **Declared** (घोषित): Something that is announced formally or officially.
 
 
• **Example:** The results of the election were declared last night.
